title: Prepare new member sub-account and stop at review screen
description: Given a member number, product type, nickname, opening deposit amount, and funding suffix code, this capability searches Member Inquiry for the member, opens the OPEN SUB-ACCOUNT form from the member detail screen, fills in the product, nickname, opening deposit and funding suffix, and submits CONTINUE to land on the REVIEW NEW SUB-ACCOUNT confirmation screen. It stops before the irreversible CONFIRM AND OPEN step, outputting the review screen for human verification.

opening_deposit.description: Opening deposit amount for the new sub-account

fund_from_suffix.description: Suffix code of the member account funding the opening deposit

steps.intent: Open Member Inquiry to look up the member
Enter the member number to search
Begin opening a new sub-account for the member
Select the product for the new sub-account
Enter the nickname for the new sub-account
Continue to the review screen without opening the account

review.notes: Recorded from a model-driven discovery run. Business outcomes are inherited from the app profile; narrow them during review.
